build_runner_from_cfg: build a FlexibleRunner from a config dict containing model, dataloader, optimizer, and training loop settings
train_model_with_runner: train a PyTorch model by calling runner.train() which executes the training loop with hooks and checkpointing
validate_model_with_runner: validate a trained model by calling runner.val() which runs the validation loop and returns metrics
test_model_with_runner: test a model by calling runner.test() which runs the test loop and returns evaluation metrics
build_dataloader_from_cfg: build a DataLoader from a config dict specifying dataset, sampler, batch size, and collate function
